assumptions: Chaining value and block uniform (SplitMix64 streams).

Estimated cost, three variants, Ch/Maj one bit per undetermined position, rounds independent: sequential (Lipmaa–Moriai on every addition), grouped (zero-difference operands of a multi-operand sum combined first, difference charged once), signed (when operand differences sit on disjoint bits, only the round outputs a', e' and each W_t must show their XOR difference: one bit condition per non-MSB difference bit; overlapping differences fall back to grouped).
Empirical following requires both the schedule difference and the full 256-bit state difference to match the trail at every round.
When no pair follows, the 95% upper bound is the rule of three (3/n).
Per-bit bias tests: two-sided z, Bonferroni over 256 bits x 65 state indices x differences.
baseline: Random permutation behaviour: trail probability 2^-256 per round-state; each state-difference bit set with probability 1/2.
conclusion: REDUCED-ROUND ONLY: deviations were detected only for reduced-round variants. These say nothing about full 64-round SHA-256/SHA-256d and give no mining advantage; full-round configurations (where tested) showed no deviation. Delta W15[31]: trail followed by >= 2 of 1048576 pairs through round 17; per-bit bias last seen at round 22; empirical minus estimate where measurable (mean, max |.|): signed -0.00 +0.03, grouped +0.35 +5.97, sequential +0.88 +14.97 bits. Delta W15[0]: trail followed by >= 2 of 1048576 pairs through round 17; per-bit bias last seen at round 22; empirical minus estimate where measurable (mean, max |.|): signed -0.01 +0.09, grouped +0.47 +6.91, sequential +0.99 +15.91 bits. Delta W8[31]: trail followed by >= 2 of 1048576 pairs through round 10; per-bit bias last seen at round 15; empirical minus estimate where measurable (mean, max |.|): signed -0.01 +0.06, grouped +0.59 +5.94, sequential +1.49 +14.94 bits. Delta W0[31]: trail followed by >= 2 of 1048576 pairs through round 2; per-bit bias last seen at round 7; empirical minus estimate where measurable (mean, max |.|): signed +0.04 +0.08, grouped +3.04 +6.08, sequential +7.54 +15.08 bits. Only rounds where pairs were observed are compared; estimates beyond them are not used for any claim, and nothing here is extrapolated to 64 rounds.

dataset.description: n random (chaining value, block) pairs; sample i from SplitMix64::stream(seed, i).

hypothesis: For a single-bit message difference, the carry-free XOR characteristic is followed by real pairs with probability measurably above 2^-256 through some number of rounds, and the Lipmaa–Moriai independence estimate predicts that probability within 1 bit wherever it is measurable.
methodology: For each difference, compute the XOR trail and its estimated cumulative log2 probability for every round 1..64. Trace n random pairs through 64 rounds; count pairs following the trail through each round; for the first n_bits pairs record every state-difference bit at every round. Compare estimated and empirical log2 probabilities where at least 30 pairs follow.
name: XOR differential characteristics of SHA-256 compression through 64 rounds
null_hypothesis: No pair follows the characteristic beyond a few rounds after the difference enters, and per-bit state differences are unbiased once diffusion completes.

reproduction.method: full rerun with identical seed and parameters on a separate Rayon pool with a different thread count; SHA-256 of the canonical deterministic results compared

verification.detail: 256 pairs x 65 state indices per difference; mismatches: []
verification.method: independent SHA-256 recomputes every per-round state difference (as output minus chaining value) and the schedule from the FIPS formula for the first pairs; following counts and all bit counts compared
